name: mapping-voices
title: Mapping Voices: An Open Atlas of Oral-History and Voice-Testimony Collections

doi.note: The concept DOI covers all versions and resolves to the latest; each release also gets its own version DOI.

description: A curated, openly licensed metadata dataset of real, publicly documented oral-history and voice-testimony collections worldwide, with normalized geographic, linguistic, thematic, and temporal metadata and a link to each holding institution's own page. The dataset describes and links to collections; it does not contain or redistribute their content.
creator: Adamu Abubakar
scope_statement: Counts and statistics describe the collections currently indexed in Mapping Voices, not the global distribution of oral history. Absence of an indexed archive for a place or language is not evidence that no oral-history tradition or collection exists.
